Two DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top of the console.
The console is sitting on a wooden surface in what appears to be a storage or workshop area.
A watermark 'DAVID ODINAKACHI JOSHUA' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible on both photos.
The console has a glossy finish with a 'STAR WARS' logo on the front face.

risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may have a storage capacity issue (e.g., 500GB instead of 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage capacity.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the 'PlayStation Network' status.
